song.zh: 宋启（宋工），2048年33岁，国家量子计算机550项目的系统工程师；偏瘦，黑色短发侧分，戴细圆钢框眼镜，右眼下有一颗小痣，穿浅灰开衫和浅蓝衬衫，挂空白工牌
song.en_name: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project)
song.en: A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.

nian_child.zh: 宋念（童年），2048年6岁的女孩，圆脸，齐刘海黑色短发，大眼睛，门牙有个小缝，穿芥末黄毛衣，手指上有蜡笔印
nian_child.en_name: little Nian (Song's daughter, 6 years old in 2048)
nian_child.role: the child who asks the question
nian_child.en: A 6-year-old Chinese girl with a round face, a straight black bob haircut with blunt bangs, big curious dark eyes, a small gap between her front teeth, rosy cheeks, a mustard-yellow knitted sweater, crayon smudges on her fingers.

boye58.zh: 2058年的波爷，44岁，宋工的同事，网络协议工程师；黑色短发夹着几缕白，胡茬，黑框眼镜（还没缠胶布），深蓝棉服配棕色毛背心
boye58.en_name: Boye at 44 (Song's colleague, network protocol engineer, in the 2050s)
boye58.en: A 44-year-old Chinese man, network protocol engineer: short black hair with the first grey streaks, dark stubble, intact black-framed glasses, a broad nose and a stubborn mouth. Dark navy quilted work jacket over a brown knitted vest.

loc_home48.zh: 2048年宋家的厨房：地表城市里的小公寓，午后阳光照在木餐桌上，桌上有蜡笔和画纸，窗外远处是在建的行星发动机脚手架
loc_home48.en_name: the Song family kitchen on the surface in 2048
loc_home48.en: Interior of a small family apartment kitchen on the Earth's surface in 2048, late afternoon: warm sunlight through a window falls across a wooden table with crayons and sheets of drawing paper, a rice cooker and a teapot on the counter, children's drawings stuck on the fridge, a potted plant; through the window a hazy city skyline and, far away on the horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal engine tower with construction cranes. Empty of people, lived-in.

loc_lab.zh: 550项目实验室（2050年代）：夜里堆满仪器的长工作台，玻璃墙后是冷白的机房，中央黑色机柜上一枚红色镜头
loc_lab.en: Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.

loc_meeting.zh: 研究院会议室（2050年代）：长会议桌、茶杯和文件，冷白顶灯，尽头墙上一枚红色镜头的黑色终端
loc_meeting.en: A plain conference room at a national research institute in the 2050s: a long table with tea cups, papers and closed laptops, rows of empty chairs, cold overhead fluorescent light, and on the far wall a black glass terminal with a single round red-glowing lens exactly like the reference image. Empty of people.

loc_restart.zh: 2058年根服务器重启行动的集结区：被水淹的地下机房边缘，三脚架探照灯照着黑水，混凝土柱子、电缆、潜水头盔和气瓶
loc_restart.en_name: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation
loc_restart.en: A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.

loc_home58.zh: 地下城的小公寓（2058/2075）：钢板墙、窄床、发蓝光的小墙屏、能看见城市竖井灯光的圆窗、折叠桌
loc_home58.en_name: Nian's cramped apartment in the underground city
loc_home58.en: A cramped family apartment in an underground city: steel walls, a narrow bunk bed, a small wall screen glowing blue, a round porthole window looking out on the lit shaft of the city, a folding table with a teapot and a worn notebook. Empty of people, dim.

loc_ceremony.zh: 2058年移交大厅：空旷肃穆的大厅，阶梯座席面对一整面黑色终端墙，中央一枚巨大的红色圆形镜头
loc_ceremony.en_name: the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority
loc_ceremony.en: A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people.

prop_drawing.zh: 念念的蜡笔画：中间一个黑色的大方块，长着一只红眼睛；周围许多彩色的小方块，都有两个点的眼睛和笑脸，用歪歪扭扭的线手拉手连在一起
prop_drawing.en: A child's crayon drawing on a sheet of slightly crumpled paper on a wooden table in sunlight: in the middle a big black square box with one round red eye; around it many small boxes in different bright colours (yellow, blue, green, orange), each with two dot eyes and a little smile, joined to each other by wobbly crayon lines like holding hands. Naive childlike strokes, no letters or words. A few crayons beside it.

prop_proto.zh: 宋工的原型节点：凹痕累累的旧铁盒、回收电路板、小散热片、三颗小灯和一根短天线，盒盖素面，没有贴纸
prop_proto.en_name: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker)
prop_proto.en: A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.

song58.zh: 2058年的宋工，43岁：同一张脸、同一副细圆钢框眼镜和小痣，两鬓斑白，胡茬，更瘦；橄榄色工程夹克，里面是黑色保温内衬
song58.en_name: Engineer Song at 43 (2058, the restart operation)
song58.en: The same man ten years later, 43: the same face, mole and thin round steel-rimmed glasses, now grey at the temples, short stubble, a thinner face with deeper lines and tired eyes. Dark olive engineering field jacket with reflective strips over a black thermal undersuit.

nian_teen.zh: 宋念（少年），2058年16岁：同一张脸，黑发扎低马尾仍留齐刘海，神情倔强，地下城的苍白肤色，旧藏青棉校服外套配灰色卫衣
nian_teen.en: A 16-year-old Chinese girl: straight black hair in a low ponytail with blunt bangs, serious guarded eyes, pale skin from living underground, a faded navy padded school jacket over a grey hoodie.

nian.zh: 宋念（成年），2075年33岁、2078年36岁，地下城调度工程师：同一张脸，齐肩黑发别在耳后，短侧刘海，冷静克制，深灰立领调度员制服，脖子上挂着耳机
nian.en_name: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078)
nian.en: A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.

prop_notebook.zh: 宋工的笔记本：磨旧的硬壳工程笔记本，第一页用发黄的胶带贴着念念的那张蜡笔画，周围和对页是密密麻麻的铅笔网络草图（小圆圈和连线），没有可读的字
prop_notebook.en_name: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page
prop_notebook.en: A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
